checkpoints.name: xor3_parallel_repetition
checkpoints.description: Theorem 1 of Bhangale-Braverman-Khot-Liu-Minzer (ECCC TR25-040; arXiv 2408.09352v1), conditional on the packaged Freiman-homomorphism inverse input FreimanAssumption (the paper's Lemma 8.1, proved there via [BKM23c, Section 2]): a 3-player XOR game of value < 1 whose question distribution has no Z-embeddings has exponentially decaying parallel-repetition value (n >= 1; the constant c may depend on the game, as in the paper).
